scope: Proposition 12.3 (Uniform admission for bounded offsets) of the manuscript “The canonical massive continuum limit of the two-dimensional O(3) model” (preprints/The-canonical-massive-continuum-limit-of-the-two-dimensional-O3-model-October-4-2026/massive-continuum-o3.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 215 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e75bfb353c2d3374), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 99. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For H sufficiently large, every depth N ≥ 1, every type P ∈ {r, +, −}, and every bare coupling β = ϑN + s with |s| ≤ R′ give a strictly admitted trajectory. Uniformly over these choices, bj = ϑj + Dj, max 0≤j≤N |Dj| ≤ CL,R′ .
